notes: Design-approval resolutions of the Art Commission, 1967-1969. The resolutions now read 'RESOLVED, That this Commission hereby approves Phase N of plans for ...' without the meeting date, so each is dated by the meeting heading before it; architects are seldom named after 1967. 416 resolutions split out of the three volumes (res7.py); 15 curated here, 13 onto pages and 2 held for a page.

coverage.remaining: 1970-1983 (same wording; architects almost never named). Within 1967-1969: airport, Sunol, Log Cabin Ranch and Hetch Hetchy items, encroachments, signs and portable classrooms skipped; not placed: Buena Vista School (Starr King Annex, Project 222), Diamond Heights High (Project 205), Louise M. Lombard School, Firehouse No. 17 on Jessie Street, the Marina Parking Facility, Bay View School (Project 921), the San Francisco Medical Center, Candlestick Park; repeat approvals of buildings already carried (Visitacion Valley Junior High, Burnett, 1680 Mission) left out.
